answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, and slash that stake when peers prove it submitted fake attestations. One honest identity is cheap to run, but a Sybil farm must fund each copy, so forging a thousand voices costs a thousand stakes while the gain stays flat. Trust accrues slowly, like a crystal forming under steady pressure, as agents wander through verified trades, and each opal-bright reputation record is tied to one stake — copying an identity means paying for it again.
